---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a school workflow or product improvement
labels: enhancement
---

## User and problem

Which admin, teacher or student need is not served today?

## Desired outcome

Describe the observable outcome rather than only a UI or technical solution.

## Scope and alternatives

What is in/out of scope, and what workarounds or simpler options were considered?

## Data, privacy and authorization

Which data/roles/classes are involved? Could this affect student, wellbeing or SOS privacy?

## API/migration/design-system impact

List expected contract, schema, component or operator changes. Open a specialized issue when the proposal needs a database migration or shared Campus Blue pattern.

## Acceptance evidence

Tests, routes, roles, viewports and documentation needed to call the feature complete.
